Q: How do I reset my company password?
A: Go to the internal SSO portal at sso.nimbuscloud.example and click 'Forgot Password'. You'll receive a reset link via your registered email within a few minutes. If you don't receive it, contact IT Helpdesk.

Q: I'm locked out of my account after too many failed logins, what do I do?
A: Accounts lock automatically after 5 failed login attempts for security reasons. Wait 15 minutes for the automatic unlock, or contact IT Helpdesk at helpdesk@nimbuscloud.example for an immediate unlock.

Q: My VPN keeps disconnecting, how can I fix it?
A: First, ensure you're on the latest VPN client version available on the IT Portal. If disconnects persist, switch to the backup VPN gateway in Settings > Network > Gateway, and report the issue to IT if it continues.

Q: How long do I have to submit an expense report?
A: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of incurring the expense. Reports submitted after 60 days will generally not be reimbursed except under exceptional circumstances approved by Finance.

Q: Can I get reimbursed for alcohol at a team dinner?
A: Alcohol is only reimbursable at approved client-facing events. Alcohol at internal, non-client team events is not a reimbursable expense under company policy.

Q: How far in advance do I need to request vacation?
A: PTO requests should be submitted at least 2 weeks in advance through the HR portal. Requests for more than 5 consecutive days also require manager approval.

Q: How many sick days do I get per year?
A: Employees accrue sick leave at 1 day per month, up to 12 days annually. Unlike PTO, sick leave does not carry over into the next calendar year.

Q: Am I eligible to work remotely right after I'm hired?
A: New employees become eligible to apply for remote work after completing their 90-day probationary period. Eligibility is then reviewed by your manager and HR business partner.

Q: Does the company pay for home office equipment?
A: Yes, eligible remote employees receive a company laptop, a docking station, and a one-time $500 home office stipend. Additional equipment requests go through the IT Asset Request Portal.

Q: I think I clicked a phishing link, what should I do?
A: Report it immediately to security@nimbuscloud.example or the #security-incidents Slack channel within 1 hour of discovery. Do not attempt to remediate it yourself — IT Security will guide you through next steps.

Q: Is MFA required for accessing the VPN?
A: Yes, multi-factor authentication is mandatory for VPN access, production systems, and the cloud infrastructure console. Disabling MFA without Security approval can result in immediate access revocation.

Q: Why was my corporate card declined?
A: Corporate cards are automatically suspended if transactions haven't been reconciled for two consecutive months. Check your Expensify account for unreconciled charges, or contact Finance if the balance looks correct.

Q: How many weeks of parental leave do I get as a father?
A: As the secondary caregiver, you're eligible for 8 weeks of fully paid parental leave. The primary caregiver receives 16 weeks.

Q: How do I report a coworker for a code of conduct violation?
A: You can report violations anonymously through the Ethics Hotline at ethics@nimbuscloud.example. Retaliation against anyone reporting in good faith is strictly prohibited under company policy.

Q: Do I need approval to expense a $50/month software subscription?
A: No, software or tool expenses up to $200/month don't require additional approval beyond standard expense submission. Above that threshold, manager sign-off is required.
